$comment: Site-owned. Path -> ISO release date (YYYY-MM-DD releases at 00:00 UTC) for pages that are not MDX. MDX entries (game pages) use frontmatter publishDate instead. A page listed here 404s in production and stays out of the sitemap until its date. Never backdate. The hockey hub is a stub: its date is the strategy's planned launch week, and the page stays noindex until data/hockey exists, so the date passing never ships a thin page. Wave 2 data pages (2026-10-21 to 2026-11-04) are hand-scheduled, two a week so the growth loop keeps its one slot under the cap of three; their CSV downloads share the page's date (src/site/download.ts).
